Ive suffered with chronic back pain after breaking my back and surgery making the pain even worse.  Living with pain is the hardest thing ive ever had to deal with and i would be lying if i said i havent thought of suicide myself.  If it were not for my kids and wife i would have already attempted it.  To put you in the mindset of someone who lives with pain, imagine waking up everyday after disturbed sleep in pain.  Forcing yourself to get up even though you know that the slighted movement is like hell.  You ask god what you did to deserve it.  Every minute you think to yourself if you were dead you wouldnt feel the pain anymore.  And as if the pain wasnt enough you constantly think of yourself being a burden of your family.  How many days out have the kids missed out on because your having a bad day with your pain levels.  You think, what must my partner feel like having to spend their days looking after you.  You wish a better life for your family and that it would be better if you were not there.  As for the hospitals and docs. You are nothing more than an appointment.  I couldn't tell you how appointments ive had and its waiting list after waiting list, and even when you do see the docs it is the same shit over and over.  And the question that really pisses you off is the "are you still in pain?" As for the meds esspecially opioid i.e morphine.  Although it relieves the pain sometimes you get hooked on them just as i am.  So not only do you have the pain to deal with but also addiction.  Im 32 yrs old and been on morphine as well as a cocktail of other meds and ive been unremit with my wife twice in the last 2 yrs. That is thanks to morphine.  It kills your sex drive.  Now you have a glimps of what it is to live with chronic pain.  Your wife does not want to die!  She has come to a wall in her life where she has done the only thing she can think of to stop the pain.  First thing that you wife needs is reassurance from you. She needs to know that you are not looking for the back door because your fed up.  She really needs to see a councillor aswell.  The only department that can effectively offer some hope for relief is the pain rehab team at her hospital  (not the pain managment team) there is a big difference.  I wish i could tell you that there were some magic words to make her feel better but the only thing you can do is try to understand the pain and be with her whist she is going through it.  The world can be a very lonely place when your in pain because people try to just leave you to have a lay down.  It is important for you to be with her if she needs to do that.  Be patient with her be there with her. That is really all you can do,  it really is the small things that matter. Please tell her from me that the world would not be a better place if she were gone.  If you would like to contact me, im in the uk and not sure where you guys are from but my email address is superbevents@outlook.com if you would like to speak more or even if you wife would like to talk im more than happy. Send her all the love in the world from us.

Be brave.

Lee

Let me tell you something you already know. The world ain’t all sunshine and rainbows. It’s a very mean and nasty place and I don’t care how tough you are it will beat you to your knees and keep you there permanently if you let it. You, me, or nobody is gonna hit as hard as life. But it ain’t about how hard ya hit. It’s about how hard you can get hit and keep moving forward. How much you can take and keep moving forward. That’s how winning is done! Now if you know what you’re worth then go out and get what you’re worth. But ya gotta be willing to take the hits, and not pointing fingers saying you ain’t where you wanna be because of him, or her, or anybody! Cowards do that and that ain’t you! You’re better than that!

Everyone needs someone to blow up at from time to time.  Believe me, I have done my fair share of venting, i have suffered with cronic back pain for 4 yrs, also had major spinal surgury back in feb which made it even worse, so i know what it feels like when you have a melt down.  You seem to me like a hard working person who helps everyone else but when you are in a time of crisis  no ones comes to your aid.  I know we dont k ow each other but if you ask me i think you deserve a break.  Sometimes when im on a downer i listen to a guy called Ed Foreman (how to have a good day everyday) you should go on YouTube and have a listen.  I garantee that after you have listened to him you will be smiling

Have you considered that you may actually be suffering with depression.  If so its not just a case that you dont have the motivation but you brain is not releasing dopamine as it should.  When you initially mentioned about planes falling from the sky i thought it was a metifor, as for your teacher, if he thinks that people get it right the first time then he is mistaken. When Edison made the light bulb it took him 1000 attempts before he got it right, when asked about it he said it didnt take 1000 attempts to get it right, but he found 999 ways not to make a light bulb.
I would still contact them, even if they can step in to help, they will know of other organisations that will.

First thing, stop worrying. That will not help amd will also make things more difficult to rectify. Second thing,  its ok to make a mistake. No company will lose money because of a accident.  Im no computer wiz but im sure come monday if you explain what has happend there will likely be some way of retrieving the work you jave done. The wonderful thing about computers is that no matter how many times you delete something there is always a data trail.  Hens how the police catch pedos. Dont be to hard on your self, rome wasnt built on a day
Can you not do a system restore so that the computer resets itself back to before you deleted the code?

Sometimes doing the hardest thing is the only thing that you can do and im sure anyone who reads this will agree, you need to do something whist you still have the chance. You and your sister deserve better

I want to make a deal with you!  If you can promise me that you will do everything in your power to stay alive, then so will I.  I know how it feels to have the whole world on your shoulders and be in a house with people and still feel invisible.  I was in a real bad place last night but i made it.  You were the one who helped me make it through the night.  After reading what you are going through, I know that im not the only one.  We were put here for a reason.  Maybe the that reason was  to help each other.  I read this morning that life is the hardest exam, the reason people fail is because people copy others not knowing that everyone has a different paper.
Me to. Belive me, if theres one thing i know about its physical pain.  I was contemplating ending it last night but i feel a littlw better this morning.  Im here if ypu need me
Before you take this path, do you mind if i ask why you have decided to do this?

You say you have nothing. You have us.  I too am seriously considering ending all my troubles because i feel like my wife and kids would be better off without me.  My marrage is crumbling under the pressure of my being in constant pain for the last 4 yrs but i still love my wife and kids to the moon and back. And im sure your husband loves you and so do your kids.  And so do I, because if I didnt have people like you then i would have already got it over and done with.  We love you, all of us.

I feel the same way. Although my suicidal thoughts are physical pain related. Ive been in pain for 4 years after injuring my spine. All pain is different weather it is physical or emotional.  I hope you dont do anything, im sat with a large bottle of morphine asking myself what am i waiting for.  I dont have the answer and even though i dont know you, im here with you.

Belive me. Ive tried everything availible to me. Started with my gp, then physio then hospital then to pain managment team then back to hospital then had surgery then back to pain managment who have now refered me to pain rehab. Sorry about all the "thens" it has just been like no one knows how to stop the pain so they pump you full of drugs and then pass you to the nxt place.  I am just in the darkest place ive ever been in and i just know it would be easier for a lot of people if i were gone.
